name: CASPER Data API
description: Static public data interface for CASPER, including its geographic/local operating sectors and club registry metadata.
sector_model: A sector is a physical/local CASPER operating area. It is not inherently a country or administrative region. Each sector can maintain its own players, clubs, leagues, competitions and seasons.
notes: CASPER is hosted as a static site, so arbitrary HTTP query execution is handled by the API client rather than a server runtime.
CSN remains the canonical source for match and competition statistics; sectors.json is the authoritative registry for operating areas and their ownership boundaries.
Club codes in player-registry.json resolve to human-readable names through the sector club registry.
